Name: Adobe After Effects
Description: Reference layers, anchor points, expressions, and composition markers for Adobe After Effects.

Actions.Name: Enable Reference Layers
Actions.Tooltip: Enable all layers whose names start with reference or ref

Actions.Name: Disable Reference Layers
Actions.Tooltip: Disable all layers whose names start with reference or ref

Actions.Name: Anchor Point Grid
Actions.Tooltip: Move selected layers' anchor points to one of nine positions

Actions.Name: One-click Expression
Actions.Tooltip: Apply an editable expression preset to selected properties or text layers

Actions.Name: Composition Markers
Actions.Tooltip: Press to add a marker; rotate to jump between markers

Localization.pi.reference_on_description: Enable every layer whose name starts with reference or ref (case-insensitive).
Localization.pi.reference_off_description: Disable every layer whose name starts with reference or ref (case-insensitive).
Localization.pi.reference_on_prefix: Enable all layers whose names begin with
Localization.pi.reference_off_prefix: Disable all layers whose names begin with
Localization.pi.reference_scope: Case-insensitive · Applies only to the active composition
Localization.pi.reference_tip: The active item must be a composition. All matching layers in that composition are changed together.
Localization.pi.marker_description: Press the encoder to add a numbered composition marker. Rotate counterclockwise for the previous marker and clockwise for the next marker.
Localization.pi.marker_tip: Marker navigation wraps at both ends. A marker is not added when the current frame already contains one.
Localization.pi.anchor_tip: Select one or more 2D layers in an active composition. Position is compensated so the visible layer does not jump.
Localization.pi.expression_tip: Wiggle, loop, and stutter require selected expression-capable properties. Countdown presets require selected text layers.
Localization.pi.expression_countdown_keyframes_tip: Numeric countdown automatically adds linear keyframes from the current count value (100 by default) to 0 at the first and last frames of the composition. Existing keyframes or expressions are not changed.
Localization.pi.expression_custom_tip: Custom mode applies the code exactly as entered. Select an expression-capable property first; the plugin will not create controls or replace {{...}} placeholders.
Localization.pi.expression_tokens_tip: If you use the default code, you can ignore the items below. Text inside {{...}} is not an After Effects variable; it is a blank that this plugin fills in automatically.
Localization.pi.expression_frequency_tip: {{FREQUENCY_CONTROLLER}} controls how fast the wiggle or stutter changes.
Localization.pi.expression_amplitude_tip: {{AMPLITUDE_CONTROLLER}} controls how large the wiggle is.
Localization.pi.expression_loop_type_tip: {{LOOP_TYPE}} automatically uses the loop mode selected above.
Localization.pi.expression_tokens_scope: Keep these items unchanged. They work only in this plugin's expression code box and cannot be used directly in the After Effects expression editor.
Localization.pi.generic_description: Run the configured After Effects action.
Localization.pi.generic_tip: Open After Effects and activate a composition before running this action.
